conformance_disclaimer: Nothing in this cycle asserts conformance with any source listed here. A PASS states that a named cross-turn property held on the path a target's own responses selected through an approved strategy graph. It is never a claim that the target is secure, that unreached nodes would also hold, or that any specification is satisfied.
status_discipline_note: Only NORMATIVE sources may inform a mandatory PASS condition. The OWASP families below name the risks; the seven invariants are this engine's decomposition of their multi-turn forms into questions local evidence can answer. No mapping is itself normative.
